body.name: \(\Gamma_J\)
body.construction: Extract a fixed channel-support and confidence-active-set description from \(\mathsf G_m(\lambda,\alpha)\); solve its algebraic stationarity and complementary-slackness equations; then certify every inactive slack and global polynomial residual on \(J\) by facewise identities, Bernstein or Handelman coefficients, or a Fritz John strengthened sum-of-squares certificate.
